s.g: Used to form adjectives from nouns or sometimes other adjectives, often relational (meaning "related to X"); a variant of -ский (-skij): -ian, -ic, -ish
-er (forms nouns denoting objects, generally tools or instruments, from verbs)
Abakan (the capital city of Khakassia, Russia)
a male given name, feminine equivalent Авре́я (Avréja)
aero-, air (referring to air or (usually) aircraft)
a transliteration of the Polish surname Wiśniewski
bog bilberry, bog blueberry, northern bilberry, western blueberry
a must, something that must be done, duty
to overshadow, to take the place (of), to push into the background
to trample down, to trample under foot
to be drained of, to shed a lot of (blood, tears, etc.)
to expire, to come to an end
to emit, to let out, to exhale
cooldown (period in a game during which a player cannot use an item or ability after it has been used)
a transliteration of the English surname Ludd
local committee (e.g. of a trade union)
to knock up [with accusative ‘someone’] (to make pregnant)
to say goodbye, to bid farewell
to settle oneself, to make oneself comfortable
to camp, to set up a camp, to take up a position
a transliteration of the English surname Rockefeller
calipers, slide gauge (device used to measure thickness between two surfaces)
